thread:
Elena: Thanks for the great questions at the all-hands. Opening this follow-up thread to capture concrete asks about customer wins/losses and the feedback loop we promised.
Marco: Quick summary from the session: loss themes = onboarding friction for Private and unpredictable pricing; wins = Dedicated latency guarantees and better SLA messaging.
Priya: Customers flagged Private deployment validation as a blocker. They want a concise deploy checklist and a faster KMS/network validation path.
Jun: I'll draft a templated Nginx + VPC example and a KMS quickstart snippet to drop in docs.
Sam: Do we have metrics showing whether cost or quality is the main reason for churn/losses in mid-market?
Priya: For mid-market it's usually cost; for enterprise it's security and SLAs. Last quarter we lost 3 deals to unit cost despite acceptable quality.
Ava: Can we produce a 1-page "ask -> owner -> ETA" that CS can hand to prospects? Short and actionable.
Elena: Yes. Marco, can you own the one-pager and coordinate Product + Docs?
Marco: I will. ETA two weeks. It will include: Dedicated SLAs, Private quickstart links, cost-saving knobs (batching, quantization), and sample rebuttals.
Priya: Add a redacted case study showing a customer moving hosted->Dedicated and reducing per-token cost ~40%. Helps GTM.
Jun: I'll pull a sanitized example from onboarding logs.
Sam: On roadmap prioritization: are we doing "private onboarding scripts" first or "console guided deploy"? Customers asked for both.
Marco: Short-term: scripts/templates (2-week spike). Medium-term: console guided flow (Q2 work).
Ava: For feedback loops, can we add a "lost-deal" CRM tag that triggers a 1-page internal postmortem routed to product weekly?
Priya: We have the tag; Rev Ops needs to wire the automation. Sarah volunteered.
Elena: Action items: Marco = one-pager (2w), Jun = case study (1w), Docs = Private quickstart (owner TBD, 2w), Rev Ops/Sarah = CRM->postmortem automation. I'll follow up in the next all-hands.
Sam: Please include expected perf numbers (p50/p95 latency ranges) on the one-pager so sales can set correct expectations.
Marco: Will include per-model p50/p95 and common batch settings.
Ava: GTM team can review drafts in 24-48h if you tag us early.
Priya: That turnaround is super helpful.
Sam: Could we also include a short decision checklist on "model variant tradeoffs" (e.g., quantized cheaper variant vs baseline)? Sales asks for guidance.
Jun: I'll add a 3-item checklist: latency target, quality tolerance, cost ceiling.
Ava: :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Reminder: created task #4572 "All-hands customer one-pager" assigned to Marco. Due 2026-04-06.
Elena: Thanks all. We'll treat this as the canonical follow-up thread and report progress in the next all-hands notes.
